layoutFurtherReading: Home layout dialog: name of the Daily reads module.
layoutSuggestedEdits: Home layout dialog: name of the Suggested edits module.
layoutMentor: Home layout dialog: name of the Mentor module.
layoutImpact: Home layout dialog: name of the Impact module.
layoutSaved: Home layout dialog: name of the Saved pages module.
layoutTrending: Home layout dialog: name of the Trending module.
layoutFeatured: Home layout dialog: name of the Featured module (Wikipedia's featured content of the day).
layoutDidYouKnow: Home layout dialog: name of the "Did you know" module (plural noun in English: the DYK hooks).
layoutRecentActivity: Home layout dialog: name of the Review changes module.
layoutActiveDiscussions: Home layout dialog: name of the Active discussions module.
yearsOld: Born on this day card: age of the person. $1 = age in years.
newList: Default name of a reading list created from the save sheet.
translationLoadError: Error on the Translate articles module when suggestions fail to load.
editedPagesMissingUsername: Personalization advanced section: error when fetching editing history without a username.
editedPagesUserNotFound: Personalization advanced section: error when the username does not exist. $1 = username as typed.
editedPagesNoEdits: Personalization advanced section: error when the user has no recent article edits. $1 = username.
